title: review verdict
description: The AI reviewer's verdict on Run's result. Every criterion must pass.

reason.description: One or two sentences, naming what you saw.

task_done.description: The deliverable does what the task asked, with the facts from the inputs.

not_broken.description: Nothing is visibly broken: layout, missing images, error text, empty sections, garbled characters.

skill_used.description: The agent really used the skill: the evidence and the result show its flow, not a generic answer.

video_ready.description: Good enough to show in a short demo video: a viewer would be impressed, not confused.

summary.description: One sentence on the result as a whole.
